data.name: Influence Animals
data.description: An animal exemplar gains the ability to influence animals of its kind, as per the wild empathy ability of a druid of its master's level with a +4 racial bonus on the check, but only for animals of its kind.

raw_tokens.value: An animal exemplar gains the ability to influence animals of its kind, as per the wild empathy ability of a druid of its master's level with a +4 racial bonus on the check, but only for animals of its kind.
It can cast charm animal three times per day as a spell-like ability against animals of its kind.|PREVARGTEQ:MasterLevel,11
It can cast dominate animal once per day as a spell-like ability against animals of its kind.|PREVARGTEQ:MasterLevel,13
